reviews.text: I used to go here all the time to wash my dogs, buy treats or bedding. Even bought 2 crates here. One afternoon I was walking my bulldog in the neighborhood and she became overheated. I stepped into the store, explained my situation and asked for some water and they flat out said no. Even after asking multiple staff members. They wouldn't do it. I was absolutely shocked. I'll never visit another pet supplies plus store in my life.

I did not know this place was here until I stumbled upon it and I appreciate the service provided while I was there. They are very helpful and friendly! Thanks for helping my kitty with all her needs!

Many people know how much I love my little girl Wicket. She started grooming with Taylor at a different location and we followed her to the Clear Lake Location. Over the past couple years I have been so satisfied with the attention and quality of services and care that my precious Wicket receives. I love that they understand that taking time to make sure she feels comfortable and safe is priority and not rushing through an appointment. I have recommended Taylor to so many people because I want the best for their babies just like I know Wicket receives.
Their customer service far exceeds the big box pet stores.  Our dog dog loves seeing Amanda and Mandy in grooming.

My dog’s grooming appointment was scheduled for 1:00 PM, and I finally got my dog back at 3:30 PM. Is 2 and a half hours normal for bath and brush?

After about an hour and a half with no updates, I decided to stop by the store. As soon as I walked in, I could hear my dog barking in the back while two groomers were standing around talking. After waiting for them to finish their conversation, I was finally greeted, but the interaction made me feel more like an inconvenience than a customer.

They told me my dog wasn’t ready yet, which was fine. I figured I should have waited for the call and decided to walk around the store while they finished. Another 30 minutes went by, and I could still hear my dog barking. When I checked again, one of the groomers Taylor who was wearing an AirPod looked over and told me it would be another 30 minutes.

It was almost 3:30 before I finally received a notification that she was ready.

This was a basic bath and brush for a small dog and it took roughly two and a half hours. , just needed some basic communication and a much more professional experience.

The biggest issue wasn’t simply the wait. It was the lack of communication, the dismissive attitude when I asked for an update, and hearing my dog barking in the back for an extended period while having no idea what was going on.

I actually go out of my way to come to this location because of the great interactions I’ve had with the dog trainers here. Unfortunately, the grooming department could use some help with the hospitality side of things. Maybe the dog trainers can train the groomers on customer service and hospitality too.

I’m posting this so other pet owners know what my experience was. Communication and customer service need serious improvement at this grooming location.

I have a cat that is now 15 years old. He's become a very picky eater in his old age. I've had to switch flavors of can cat food too many times to count. This place has the widest variety of individual canned cat food that I've ever seen. He tends to like fancy feast and if your cat prefers that brand, they carry every individual flavor that's made. Even the gravy select ones that at other stores only come by the 12 pack case. My cat only likes 2 of the 4 flavors that come in the 12 pack case, so I was wasting money hand over fist. Not any more. Now I can buy the 2 flavors individually that he likes along with several other of their normal variety flavors. He only likes pate style and seafood flavors This place is a god send.
